logline: 기숙사의 모든 편지를 막아 온 사감의 방에서, 밤마다 두 사람 목소리가 새어 나온다.
destination: 사감 방문 — 학생들이 끝내 열어 보는 자리
protagonist: 여학교 기숙사를 홀로 다스리는 마흔 살 사감
setting: 1920년대 경성 여학교 기숙사, 긴 복도와 잠긴 방
anchor: a gaunt middle-aged woman in a black skirt and white blouse, hair pulled tight, thin set mouth
palette: dim corridor amber, cold white plaster, deep doorway shadow, thin moonlight

beats.beat: 사감이 복도를 돌며 문을 하나씩 확인한다.
beats.visual: a severe middle-aged woman walking a long dormitory corridor testing door handles one by one
beats.motion: her hand turns each handle, her heels click, the corridor lamp sways

beats.beat: 그녀는 학생 손에서 무언가를 빼앗아 서랍에 넣는다.
beats.visual: a woman's hand dropping a folded pink slip into a desk drawer, a girl standing rigid nearby
beats.motion: the drawer slides shut, the girl's head drops, the key turns

beats.beat: 밤이면 그 방에서 두 사람 목소리가 난다.
beats.visual: a closed door at the end of a dark corridor with warm light leaking under it, empty hallway
beats.motion: the light under the door flickers, dust turns in the beam, the corridor stays still

beats.beat: 학생 셋이 발소리를 죽이고 복도를 지난다.
beats.visual: three girls in white nightclothes creeping barefoot along a dark corridor toward a lit door
beats.motion: bare feet lift and settle, one girl grabs another's sleeve, shadows stretch

beats.visual: a thin band of lamplight under a wooden door wavering, three pairs of bare feet stopped before it
beats.motion: the band of light wavers and narrows, feet shuffle back, a floorboard bends

beats.visual: three girls pressing their ears against a closed door, eyes wide, corridor dark behind them
beats.motion: their heads press closer, one clamps a hand over her mouth, the lamp dims

beats.visual: a door standing ajar with warm lamplight spilling into a dark corridor, three girls silhouetted
beats.motion: the door swings inward, light floods the corridor, their shadows leap back

beats.beat: 새벽 복도 끝에 문 하나가 열려 있다.
beats.visual: a single door standing ajar at the end of an empty dormitory corridor at dawn, pale light beyond
beats.motion: the door drifts a hand's width, dawn light widens on the floor, dust turns

withheld: 혼자였다는 것과 빼앗은 편지로 벌이던 연인 놀이
